row.notes: strrchr(s, c), not strchr/strlen: c==0 returns the terminator (pcmpeqb zero scan); else CPU-level paths (0x145f7f5f8) keep the LAST match (bit-scan-reverse on match masks, pcmpistri imm 0x40 = most significant index). Call sites pass backslash then '/' (0x1406c53fa/0x1406c5412, Render_FileStream_ResolveWritePath) and '?' (Game_Breakable_SpawnPieceRenderModel) to split paths. 20 sites. Better name: Ne_Crt_StrrchrSse (bound record keeps its name).
